[EN] Our brothers who were enslaved by the gulas think of us as traitors. And yet it's our duty to free them from their oppressors.

We can't do it without your help.
[ES] Nuestros hermanos que fueron esclavizados por las gulas nos consideran traidores. Y, sin embargo, es nuestro deber liberarlos de sus opresores.

No podemos hacerlo sin tu ayuda.

[EN] Graatush has betrayed Badoask!
[ES] ¡Graatush ha traicionado a Badoask!

[EN] We won't forgive Graatush for driving the orcans to ruin!
[ES] ¡No perdonaremos a Graatush por llevar a los orcans a la ruina!
